svg.text: Z1 vs Z2 — identical scale, identical z-mapping, aligned on the PCB backside

Section at y = 0 through the middle row of cells. Horizontal 15 px/mm; vertical scale ×6 (vertical exaggeration). Layers thinner than 80 µm are drawn at a minimum height (as 80 µm thick); true thickness labelled. Z1 and Z2 share one z-mapping.
Z1 — converter embedded between substrate and die
Z1 converts inside the package, then a short 1 V vertical path to
Z2 — converter on the substrate backside, inside the PCB opening
Z2 converts below the substrate, in the PCB opening, and sends
1 V vertically through the substrate TSVs
